comment: Every picture frame of Claude (0.5.0 adds blinkHalf, write, webSearch, skill and plug): its name, its kind (solo: 70x40 logical pixels, a box of 8 cells by 2 rows; scene: 105x40, 12 cells by 2 rows, drawn only beside the spinner), the solo frame the footer shows in a scene's place, and the braille pose that stands in where the terminal has no graphics. scripts/make-frames.py draws one PNG per entry; hooks/lib/sprite.ts mirrors this table and a test holds the two together.

frames.name: idle
frames.what: standing, eyes open, relaxed

frames.name: idleUp
frames.what: the top of a breath: one pixel taller, arms a pixel higher

frames.name: blink
frames.what: eyes shut for a blink

frames.name: lookL
frames.what: eyes to the left

frames.name: lookR
frames.what: eyes to the right

frames.name: lookUp
frames.what: eyes up, pondering

frames.name: lookDown
frames.what: eyes down, concentrating

frames.name: armsIn
frames.what: arms tucked forward, as if typing

frames.name: stepA
frames.what: walk, first step

frames.name: stepB
frames.what: walk, second step, one pixel up

frames.name: hop1
frames.what: crouch before a hop: squashed, wider, legs bent

frames.name: hop2
frames.what: in the air: stretched, arms up, legs dangling, small ground shadow

frames.name: hop3
frames.what: landing squash

frames.name: wave1
frames.what: right arm raised high, happy eyes

frames.name: wave2
frames.what: the raised arm tilted the other way, happy eyes

frames.name: flinch
frames.what: eyes squeezed shut, recoiled, a sweat drop

frames.name: cheer1
frames.what: both arms up, happy eyes, sparkles starting

frames.name: cheer2
frames.what: off the ground, confetti at its widest

frames.name: cheer3
frames.what: landing, confetti falling

frames.name: yawn1
frames.what: eyes squeezed, a small round mouth opening, arms stretching out

frames.name: yawn2
frames.what: the yawn at its widest, arms fully stretched

frames.name: sip1
frames.what: holding a small mug, steam rising

frames.name: sip2
frames.what: the mug at the face, eyes closed, content

frames.name: sweat1
frames.what: worried eyes glancing left (toward the context gauge), a sweat drop at the temple

frames.name: sweat2
frames.what: the same, the drop lower

frames.name: clock1
frames.what: holding a small hourglass, looking at it

frames.name: clock2
frames.what: the hourglass with more sand fallen, eyes a little wider

frames.name: pumpkin1
frames.what: a small jack-o'-lantern beside him, glowing

frames.name: pumpkin2
frames.what: the lantern's glow flickered dimmer, Claude smiling at it with happy eyes

frames.name: sleep1
frames.what: asleep: settled low, eyes closed, a small z

frames.name: sleep2
frames.what: breathing in: one pixel higher, z and a bigger Z drifting up

frames.name: sleep3
frames.what: breathing out, the Zs higher and fading

frames.name: sleepCold1
frames.what: asleep with frost on his top edge and a small snowflake (the prompt cache went cold)

frames.name: sleepCold2
frames.what: the same, breathing, the snowflake turned

frames.name: think1
frames.what: eyes up and right; a thought bubble at the upper right holding one dot

frames.name: think2
frames.what: the bubble holding two dots

frames.name: think3
frames.what: the bubble holding three dots

frames.name: read1
frames.what: an open book held to the right, eyes on its left page

frames.name: read2
frames.what: eyes on the right page

frames.name: read3
frames.what: a page in mid-turn

frames.name: search1
frames.what: a magnifying glass over the first of a few faint text lines

frames.name: search2
frames.what: the glass over the middle line, one word under it lit

frames.name: search3
frames.what: the glass over the last line

frames.name: type1
frames.what: at a small laptop, left arm down on the keys, a line of code on its screen

frames.name: type2
frames.what: right arm down, the line longer

frames.name: type3
frames.what: left arm down, a second line started

frames.name: run1
frames.what: a small terminal window: a prompt and a caret

frames.name: run2
frames.what: output lines appearing, the caret off

frames.name: run3
frames.what: more output, the caret on

frames.name: web1
frames.what: a small globe, its land at the left

frames.name: web2
frames.what: the globe turned a third

frames.name: web3
frames.what: the globe turned two thirds

frames.name: team1a
frames.what: one small Claude helper at the right, mid-bob; the big one gesturing toward it

frames.name: team1b
frames.what: the helper down

frames.name: team2a
frames.what: two helpers, the first up

frames.name: team2b
frames.what: two helpers, the second up

frames.name: team3a
frames.what: three helpers, the outer two up

frames.name: team3b
frames.what: three helpers, the middle one up

frames.name: ask1
frames.what: a yellow speech bubble with an exclamation mark, Claude waving at the viewer

frames.name: ask2
frames.what: the bubble a pixel higher, the arm tilted the other way

frames.name: work1
frames.what: a small gear at the right, Claude's arm on it

frames.name: work2
frames.what: the gear turned an eighth

frames.name: blinkHalf
frames.what: eyes half closed (4 px tall), the frame between open and shut

frames.name: write1
frames.what: a pale notepad page at the right with faint rules; a mauve pen held in his right arm at the start of the first line, one short ink stroke written

frames.name: write2
frames.what: the first line longer, the pen further right

frames.name: write3
frames.what: two lines written, the pen at the end of the second, a small ink dot

frames.name: webSearch1
frames.what: the globe as in web1 with the magnifying glass over its upper left

frames.name: webSearch2
frames.what: the globe turned a third, the glass over its middle, the land under it brighter

frames.name: webSearch3
frames.what: the globe turned two thirds, the glass over its lower right

frames.name: skill1
frames.what: a parchment scroll half unrolled at the right (pale yellow paper, lavender rods), two faint lines showing

frames.name: skill2
frames.what: the scroll fully unrolled, four faint lines and a small green check at the bottom

frames.name: plug1
frames.what: a cable from his right arm ending in a plug a few pixels short of a wall socket at the right (surface-colored plate, two dark slots)

frames.name: plug2
frames.what: the plug in the socket, a small yellow spark at the join
